resolved_conflicts.explanation: The lookout page says removed, while an OpenStreetMap-based map entry still shows a tower feature named Belcross Lookout Tower near Camden. The map entry has no date or condition, so the record follows the lookout page and the story says the map entry does not show a standing structure.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The lookout page gives county, agency and the removed status only: no build date, height, design or staffing. The statewide list agrees on county and agency and gives no other detail. The OpenStreetMap-based entry (Mapcarta) lists a tower feature near Camden, typed as a tower; the cached page gives no coordinates, date or condition, so it is recorded as a conflict, not as evidence of a standing tower. Two WebSearch queries run; the Natural Atlas page returned only site navigation and the anyplaceamerica page returned HTTP 403. The story runs about 125 words because no more evidence exists in the sources read; the editor may decide whether to keep it short. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story now says Mapcarta lists the tower near Camden, not at the statewide list's coordinates, and it no longer says the entry gives coordinates; the tnlandforms.us byline is dropped.
